verdict.rationale: Algolia lists AI Search (NeuralSearch) as hosted hybrid keyword + vector semantic search, and its llms.txt describes hosted APIs for AI-powered semantic search. This implies vectorization happens on Algolia's side, but no evidence explicitly says Algolia embeds documents and queries for you or describes how. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of managed or built-in embedding of records and queries, embedder or model configuration and choice, confirmation that no external embedding pipeline is needed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
